exposure: timing of MMV diagnosis relative to pregnancy
outcome: Cerebral events (ischemic events, headache) during perinatal period
cohort: 31 patients with Moyamoya vasculopathy (MMV), including MMD, unilateral MMD, and quasi MMD, who had a history of pregnancy and were treated at a single European institution.
finding: Surgical treatment appears to have a protective effect against cerebral events during pregnancy and delivery for patients already diagnosed with Moyamoya vasculopathy.
country: N/A (European, but specific country not stated)
